# Hand-written before cfm-dotnet ran (CFM-503).
#
#   <source> -> <target> <method> <confidence>   the edge must exist
#   ! <source> -> <target>                        no such edge (decoys, non-web methods)
#   ! file <prefix>                               no node is located in a file under <prefix>
#   body <function> <type> <binder>               the function binds that request body
#   test <function> <cond or case label>          that if/case carries a body test that isn't just "unknown"
#
# Labels: an endpoint is "METHOD path", a function is its name "(Type).Method", an external is
# "ext:<namespace>.(Type).Method" and an unresolved node is "unresolved:<call text>".

# --- entry points
POST /PaymentService.asmx/Pay -> (PaymentService).Pay framework_registration high
POST /PaymentService.asmx/Status -> (PaymentService).GetStatus framework_registration high
GET /api/health -> (PaymentApi).Health framework_registration medium
POST /api/inquiry -> (InquiryAdapter).Handle framework_registration medium
EVENT Application_Start -> (Global_asax).Application_Start framework_registration high
! POST /PaymentService.asmx/NotExposed

# --- calls: static
(PaymentService).Pay -> (PaymentController).Pay static high
(PaymentService).GetStatus -> (PaymentController).Status static high
(PaymentController).Pay -> (EsbClient).Send static high
(PaymentController).Pay -> (PaymentController).Reject static high
(PaymentController).Pay -> (AuditLogs).Create static high
(PaymentController).Pay -> ext:System.(String).IsNullOrEmpty static high
(PaymentController).Pay -> ext:System.(String).ToUpper static high
(PaymentController).Status -> (EsbClient).Send static high
(EsbClient).Send -> (EsbClient).Post static high
(EsbClient).Post -> ext:System.Net.(WebRequest).Create static high
(EsbClient).Post -> ext:System.Net.(HttpWebRequest).GetResponse static high
(SmsNotifier).Notify -> (EsbClient).Post static high
(DbAuditLog).Write -> ext:System.Data.SqlClient.(SqlCommand).ExecuteNonQuery static high
(PaymentApi).ProcessRequest -> (PaymentApi).GetRoutes static high
(PaymentApi).ProcessRequest -> (Route).Dispatch static high
(PaymentApi).GetRoutes -> (Route).Get static high
(PaymentApi).GetRoutes -> (Route).Post static high
(InquiryAdapter).Handle -> ext:System.Web.Script.Serialization.(JavaScriptSerializer).Deserialize static high
(InquiryAdapter).Handle -> (PaymentController).Status static high
(Global_asax).Application_Start -> ext:System.Web.Routing.(RouteCollection).Add static high

# --- calls through an interface
# The field is only ever assigned `new SmsNotifier()`.
(PaymentController).Pay -> (SmsNotifier).Notify vta medium
! (PaymentController).Pay -> (EmailNotifier).Notify
# The receiver comes from a factory; DbAuditLog is the only IAuditLog created with `new` anywhere.
(PaymentController).Pay -> (DbAuditLog).Write vta medium
! (PaymentController).Pay -> (FileAuditLog).Write

# --- honest gaps
(Route).Dispatch -> unresolved:handler(context) unresolved unknown

# --- exclusions: Backup/ holds a second PaymentController that must not load
! file Backup/

# --- request bodies and body tests
body (PaymentService).Pay PayRequest WebMethod
body (InquiryAdapter).Handle InquiryRequest Deserialize
test (PaymentController).Pay string.IsNullOrEmpty(req.Source.Bank)
test (PaymentController).Pay req.Express && req.Amount > 1000
test (PaymentController).Pay "IDR"
test (PaymentController).Pay "USD", "SGD"
test (PaymentController).Pay default
test (InquiryAdapter).Handle req.Kind == "status" && req.Tenor >= 12
